Christmas Break Hotel Package
Escape the everyday and enjoy one of the most magical Christmas Break Hotel Packages near Darlington, where festive dining, castle accommodation and unforgettable Christmas memories await.

Walworth Castle Christmas Break Hotel Package
Leave the cooking, hosting and washing up behind this festive period and enjoy a relaxing two-night Christmas Break Hotel Package at Walworth Castle.

• Festive treats and mulled wine on arrival
• Two-course evening meal
• Pre-dinner cocktail
• Christmas movies and loaded popcorn in our lounge
• Overnight accommodation with breakfast on Christmas morning
Christmas Day
Wake up to the magic of Christmas and enjoy a day of festive indulgence.
Your Christmas Day includes:
• Welcome glass of prosecco
• Traditional Christmas Day lunch
• Relaxed evening buffet
• Christmas movies and loaded popcorn in our lounge
• Overnight accommodation with breakfast on Boxing Day

Accommodation in Darlington | Rooms at Walworth Castle
Accommodation in Darlington with a Difference
Stay at Walworth Castle and experience a unique alternative to standard accommodation in Darlington. With character rooms and peaceful surroundings, it’s a stay that feels a little different.
Find the Right Accommodation in Darlington
We have a range of rooms to suit accommodation in Darlington requirements, from standard bedrooms to spacious suites, including a stunning bridal suite perfect for your wedding night. Some rooms even feature original castle details, offering a true sense of history. From peaceful breaks to history-filled stays, Walworth Castle in Darlington is ready to welcome you.
Book your stay at Walworth Castle Hotel today and experience the charm of an authentic English castle.
King James I Suite
The newly reimagined King James I Suite is a perfect spot for a romantic escape and features a large, spacious living room, a standalone bath and couples showers in the bathroom, and a bedroom tucked away in one of the castle s towers with views overlooking the castle grounds.
King James VI of Scotland actually stayed in what is now the King James Suite on 14th April 1603 when he was entertained by Elizabeth Jenison, the then owner of Walworth Castle, on his journey to becoming King James I at his coronation in London.
Book Now
Four Poster - Suite
The ultimate in a luxury stay. These rooms are extra large and comprise of a four-poster bed, some of which are located within the castle s towers. Some have a separate lounge area with sofa for you to relax.
Check Availability
Four Poster - Superior Double
These rooms comprise of a four poster bed and are located within the main castle. If you want a bit of luxury and want to treat that special person in your life, then where better to stay than in a romantic castle with a four-poster bed.
Check Availability
Castle Rooms
Castle rooms have either twin or double beds and are located within the main castle. They are of all different shapes and sizes, some of which have original features.
Check Availability
Annex Rooms
Stay in one of our Annex rooms, located in an adjoining building next to the castle and have a choice of double or twin beds. It’s a great way to enjoy the castle experience—including dining and exploring the grounds—at a standard room rate.
Check Availability
Walworth Castle Lodge Accommodation in Darlington
This impressive gatehouse is located at the entranceway to Walworth Castle Hotel and accommodates 6 guests in very comfortable surroundings. With 2 lounges and its own private garden, Walworth Castle Lodge is the perfect getaway for the family. It is also dog friendly and has a hot tub in the garden.
Find Out More
Walworth Castle Holiday Cottage Accommodation in Darlington
Walworth Castle Holiday Cottage is located within the grounds of the hotel is perfect for a family getaway. Comprising of 2 bedrooms, one being a twin and one a double. There is also a kitchen diner and bathroom. The cottage is pet-friendly, and there are lots of lawns and woodlands for your four-legged friends to explore. The enclosed yard at the rear has a hot tub and patio.

wikipedia.title: Walworth Castle
wikipedia.extract: Walworth Castle is a castle of 12th-century origins, situated at Walworth, near Darlington, County Durham, England. It is a Grade I listed building. It was completed around 1600, probably by Thomas Holt for Thomas Jenison. It stands on the site of a former manor house or castle built in the 12th century by the Hansard family. The estate passed through the hands of the Ayscoughs and Aylmers besides the Hansards and Jenisons, and became a prisoner-of-war camp during World War II and then a girls' boarding school after the war. It has been a hotel since 1981.
